newsitem.title: USA: Hewlett-Packard cuts Vectra PC prices. [CORRECTED 17:57 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Hewlett-Packard cuts Vectra PC prices. [CORRECTED 17:57 GMT]

text.p: Hewlett-Packard Co said it is cutting prices on the HP Vectra line of commercial and high-performance personal computers and will soon ship Pentium Pro models with Microsoft's Windows NT Workstation 4.0.

Hewlett-Packard said in a statement that prices were being reduced by up to 17 percent, for its HP Vectra VL 5/166 desktop machine, and that its commercial HP Vectra VE, VL and VA computer prices now may start at $1,056.
High-performance HP Vectra XM and XA personal computers prices now may start at $1,387 (corrects from "$1,487"), it said.
